hookups.source: No operator page exists (web searches 2026-11-09 find only directories and hotel resellers; Google Maps lists no website). The stored 50A / water / sewer were derived from note prose resting only on directory listings (campgroundviews, allstays), so they are cleared.

note: Branson RV park beside a motel on the Shepherd of the Hills Expressway, near the Strip; no website of its own, and directory listings describe full-hookup back-in sites. Long-term sites sit behind the motel and overnight sites beside the parking lot by the pool (RV Life reviewer, Dec 2024). --Claude
summary: No operator website (rvparky directory link stays only for lack of one). Google 3.8 over 384 (motel + RV park combined, phone 417-334-8890); RV Life 11 reviews, camper rates $43 (Dec 2024) / $45 (Jun 2024); Branson gateway 6 km. Directory-only hookups cleared. Drop candidate on the under-4 Google rule.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (under-4 rule, AWH 2026-11-02): Google Maps 'Willow Tree Inn & RV Park' is 3.8 over 384 reviews (25+), open, phone +1 417-334-8890, no website. The listing covers the motel and the RV park together, and the recent reviews read are about the motel rooms ('The rooms were clean. The air conditioning worked excellent.'; 'Stayed at this hotel for one week ... Rooms were very clean'), so the 3.8 is mostly a motel score - but it is the park's only Google listing. No --AWH note. RV Life (stored rating 4*, $$) shows 11 reviews.

PRESENCE: no operator website found; the stored website is an RV Parky directory page (aggregator). Presence rests on the Google listing (open, 384 reviews, phone) - passes the amended rule. Pitchup lists it (403 to plain HTTP, unread; whether it is bookable there is unverified). Suggest removing the rvparky link or leaving website empty.

PRICE: no posted rate anywhere from the operator. RV Life camper reports: $43 a night (stay Dec 2024), $45 (Jun 2024). Under $50 either way, and Branson (attraction) is 6 km away (gateways.py), so the gate is moot.

LONG-STAY: an RV Life reviewer (2019 Grand Design Reflection, stay Dec 2024): 'Long term in the back of motel and short term off the side of the parking lot by the pool. Easy to get in and out. A little tight for large campers with slides on both sides'. Earlier search snippets mention 'special monthly rates'. Short-term sites exist, but with no posted nightly rate and no booking engine, test 2 fails if AWH reads the park as long-stay in character; the share of nightly sites is unknown (RV Life: 35 sites).
Phone: entry has none; Google gives 417-334-8890 (RV Life 417-334-8868). apply.py does not write phone.
Rig fit: an RV Life reviewer (Jun 2024): 'Try reserving sites 3, 4, or 5 they are in full or part shade. Our 34' rig is about all...' - a 23-ft rig fits.
